items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: my first job was with Johnny Mitchell... Johnny was the leader on sax... myself on trumpet

ctx.x: I arrived in Los Angeles on Thanksgiving Day, 1925 to play great with the Sunnyland Band. For certain reasons I did not play with that band, so my first job was with Johnny Mitchell and the cafe downtown L.A., called the Italian Village.
Johnny was the leader on sax, Kenny Prince on piano, Les Hite, sax, Lionel Hampton, drums, myself on trumpet and a banjo player, I don't remember his name.
